protocolPage.disclaimerP1Bold: NutriVigil provides educational information and general guidance only.
protocolPage.disclaimerP1Rest: Our recommendations are based on evidence-based dietary guidelines but should not replace professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
protocolPage.disclaimerP2: Always consult your healthcare provider, registered dietitian, or qualified medical professional before making significant changes to your diet, especially if you have existing health conditions or take medications.
protocolPage.disclaimerP3: Individual nutritional needs vary greatly based on medical history, current health status, medications, and other factors. What works for one person may not be appropriate for another.
protocolPage.disclaimerP4: In case of emergency or severe symptoms, seek immediate medical attention.

diabetes.title: Diabetes Management
diabetes.description: Manage blood sugar levels through mindful carbohydrate intake and balanced nutrition.
donts: Limit white bread and refined grains
Skip processed snacks high in sugar
Avoid fruit juices with added sugar

nutrients.name: Sugar
nutrients.note: Limit added sugars, watch natural sugars

nutrients.name: Protein
nutrients.note: Include lean sources at each meal

hypertension.title: Hypertension (High Blood Pressure)
hypertension.description: Control blood pressure through reduced sodium intake and heart-healthy foods.
dos: Use herbs and spices for flavor

heart.title: Heart Disease
heart.description: Protect heart health by managing cholesterol, fats, and maintaining healthy weight.
dos: Eat plenty of vegetables and fruits
donts: Avoid trans fats and partially hydrogenated oils

kidney.title: Kidney Disease
kidney.description: Support kidney function by managing protein, potassium, phosphorus, and sodium.
dos: Stay within fluid limits if prescribed
donts: Skip processed foods high in sodium
Avoid dark colas and certain beverages

nutrients.name: Protein
nutrients.note: Moderate intake as advised by doctor

obesity.title: Obesity & Weight Management
obesity.description: Achieve healthy weight through balanced nutrition, portion control, and mindful eating.
donts: Skip large portions and second helpings
Avoid eating out of boredom or stress

nutrients.name: Protein
nutrients.note: Helps preserve muscle during weight loss

allergies.title: Food Allergies
allergies.description: Avoid allergens and prevent cross-contamination while maintaining balanced nutrition.
dos: Ask about ingredients when eating out
donts: Don't risk trying new foods without checking

nutrients.name: Common Allergens
nutrients.note: Milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soy
